g.title: cluster_flow
g.text: STORY WORKFLOW - code decides the order; every model call has one job (bedtime/simple.py)

g.title: cluster_alt
g.text: Also in the repo - the earlier agent designs (BEDTIME_MODE=whole | room)

g.title: user
g.text: name · age 5-10 · something from today · a shelf (11 kinds of story, Surprise me, My own idea)

g.title: guard
g.text: clean text · real names only · injection phrases

g.title: screen
g.text: Safety screen (LLM, only for "My own idea")
soften or block · original characters · pick the kind

g.title: ideas
g.text: 98 hand-written seeds: a want · a funny obstacle · a twist
space & animal seeds: a hero who LIVES a true fact

g.title: listener
g.text: a child of this age hears 3 ideas, picks one + says why

g.title: library
g.text: sent as the writer's "own earlier story": its voice AND its length

g.title: writers
g.text: the idea + age rules + the story's shape:
3 ideas that go wrong, the hero's own idea works - or, if it teaches a fact,
3 silly wrong guesses, then the true answer · ends asleep

g.title: pairwise
g.text: SIDE-BY-SIDE JUDGE (LLM, every pair × both orders, in parallel)
plot · creativity · development · language · bedtime fit
a win counts only if both orders agree

g.title: checks
g.text: age words & real hazards · repeats · copying the example
stock phrases · hard words · talking · true fact explained

g.title: reviser
g.text: the judge's notes, whole story at once

g.title: tidy
g.text: speech tags with their quotes · "said"/"asked" · no named-feeling tails
sentences too long for one breath are split · pages

g.title: out
g.text: STORY on the page: title page + pages · read aloud with the computer's own voice
the steps appear on the book's cover while it is written (about 10-20 seconds, ~13 model calls)

g.title: knock
g.text: unsafe words · far too short · no bedtime ending
drafts inside the age's word range go first

g.title: judge
g.text: safety veto · yes/no checklist · up to 3 fixes
score computed in code (not by the model)

g.title: double
g.text: keeps only real problems · if unsure, keeps the flag

g.title: keep
g.text: Re-judged; the revision is KEPT ONLY IF IT RANKS HIGHER
(safe → inside the word range → fewer problems → score)

g.title: change
g.text: the Storyteller agent edits the story page by page,

g.title: alt
g.text: A tool-calling STORYTELLER AGENT (gpt-3.5) chooses its own next step:
write_drafts / write_part → review_story → rewrite_passage → read_aloud → finish
with code guardrails and an autopilot fallback.
Replaced as the default after real runs: its page-by-page patches broke stories,
and a labelled beat sheet leaked into the prose.
